title: /ops: a heavy listing page is shot in one load, a queued baseline says it waits, the install door answers at once and never 502, shots are named per release, a stale tab is told to reload, and the whole template row opens it
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-host/test/capture.test.mjs
S3: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a Postgres the suite may make scratch schemas in, run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/ops-demos.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/ops-capture.test.mjs
S6: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts of each run.
expect: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.
S1: a shot over the byte ceiling opens ONE context and calls goto once; the lighter steps are screenshots of that page, the retake with scale 'css'.

S2: while another process holds the heavy lock, stderr carries '==> waiting for another site's webroot baseline' and no building line; once released, '==> building the webroot baseline (ADR 0073)' follows and stdout's last line is JSON with ok true.

S3: a host answering 502 HTML gives 503 application/json with error DEMO_HOST_UNAVAILABLE, host, reason and Retry-After 60; a host that never answers is answered in under 3 s; a slow host gives 202 at once with jobId equal to keyedJobId(jobKey) and a second press 409; a host that never takes the job leaves the job state failed with a 'did not answer' reason and the next press reuses the jobKey with no teardown.

S3: tracy-business/j6 and tracy-business/emdash-0.x shooting key home store tracy-business-j6-home-1440.png and tracy-business-emdash-0-x-home-1440.png, and a pre-existing tracy-business-home-1440.png keeps its bytes.
S4: two POST /_host/teardown with the same jobKey answer the same keyed id (second with reused true) and run teardown once; a jobKey with a space is 400.

S5: a changed /ops entry script is reported once; a click on the thumbnail, name, version chip, warnings pill, warnings cell, chevron cell and chevron each opens the template once; the row has tabindex 0, nothing inside is a tab stop, Enter opens it.
evidence: cowork.tracy.site, 12/10/2026: ja-vogue category-2 'shot timed out after 30000ms' x4; 8 fleet01 installs all on 'building the webroot baseline' for 10+ min; 13 Cloudflare 502 pages on POST /api/ops/demos/install after a 40 s press; tracy-business wp7 and emdash sharing tracy-business-<key>-<width>.png; a pre-#1255 tab stuck on Reading…; the Warnings cell of a Templates row opening nothing.
fence: Real makeShoot with a fake Playwright, the real webroot-git.sh with a real flock, the real doors over a fake demo host and real Postgres, the harness modules on linkedom. Not exercised: Chromium itself, fleet01's load, Cloudflare.
